title: The predictability of clear aligner treatment in space opening for permanent maxillary lateral incisors: An observational retrospective cohort study
html: Space opening with clear aligner therapy has been little researched. The aim of this retrospective observational study was to investigate the predictability of the Invisalign appliance (Align Technology, San José, Calif) in opening space for the permanent maxillary lateral incisor (PMLI).
